name: One Evening
source:
This visual novel tells the story of the main character and his life in Russia. This protagonist is Sasha, a guy who loves going on walks and finding adventure. But then, a new person appears in his boring life, someone ready to brighten up the dull grey days of the Moscow suburbs.

[Translated from [url=https://t.me/Oneeveningofficial/16]Telegram[/url]]
